dedupe_keys.name: supporting data for high fidelity inference of power grid frequency distributions

description: Alessandro Lonardi and colleagues publish power-grid frequency measurements from London and Stellenbosch for a study of frequency-distribution inference. Zenodo serves two large CSV files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The linked public code repository says two phasor measurement units recorded data from 28 April to 31 December 2025 at one-second resolution. The series can calibrate grid-frequency dynamics or test statistical inference methods under ordinary operation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this two-location release. A limitation is that two measurement points do not represent every node or all operating regimes in the UK and South African systems. The Zenodo page does not describe missing values, calibration or exact sensor placement. The linked MIT code has separate rights from the CC BY data. Neither CSV was downloaded, and no frequency distribution was recalculated.
